$comment: Canonical declaration of GitHub Actions CI gate enforcement status (blocking / advisory / manual / automated). This is the machine-checked source of truth: scripts/quality/check-gate-parity.mjs verifies it against the parsed workflow YAML and against scripts/quality/branch-protection.snapshot.json (the observed live GitHub branch protection state). manualWorkflows are workflow_dispatch-only; automatedWorkflows may also run on push to main. See issue #652 and docs/ci-structure.md.

manualJobs.note: Dispatch-gated (workflow_dispatch with inputs.full=true); not a pull_request/push required-status-check producer.
